label: Confirm the irreversible change
description: A gate BEFORE the work, not after: the point of confirming an irreversible change is that it has not happened yet (feature.md §5). Entered only when the plan contains one — explore's mount skips straight to implement otherwise.

binding.text: This plan contains an irreversible change — a migration that will have run, a contract that will be published, or data that will be deleted. The recovery plan is in the plan beside this prompt. Nothing has happened yet.

inputs.plan.description: The chosen decomposition, including its recovery plan.
